response.sql: WITH id_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) as avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) as mean_avg_ana FROM id_averages) SELECT id_averages.ID, id_averages.avg_ana, id_averages.avg_ana - overall_mean.mean_avg_ana as gap FROM id_averages, overall_mean WHERE id_averages.avg_ana > overall_mean.mean_avg_ana ORDER BY gap IS NULL, gap DESC LIMIT 10
